Container.Name: Dualarr
Container.Overview: A companion to Sonarr for anime. Dualarr checks the audio and subtitle languages of every anime file Sonarr has, and keeps them in Japanese with subtitles: it flags files without Japanese audio (English-only dubs) or without subtitles, and replaces them in one click (blocklist, delete, search again). It also sets up two custom formats in Sonarr so subbed-only releases are upgraded to dual audio (Japanese + English) once the dub comes out, and dub-only releases are never grabbed. Optionally it checks the files themselves instead of trusting their language tags: whisper.cpp listens to each audio track and the subtitles are read, which catches mislabelled releases and signs & songs-only subtitles. This runs on the CPU, or on an Intel or AMD iGPU when you pass /dev/dri (for an NVIDIA card, install Dualarr-NVIDIA instead). A nightly scan searches a few series at a time and can notify you (Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, webhook) about upgrades and problems. The first visit creates your login; then connect Sonarr and apply the custom formats from Settings.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: anime sonarr dual audio dub sub subtitles japanese custom formats whisper
Container.Requires: Sonarr v4 with "Analyse video files" on (Settings → Media Management), so it knows each file's audio and subtitle languages.
Container.Changes:
### 0.3.0 (2026-09-29) - Per quality profile: dual audio (original + English), or the original language only. In an original-only profile, dual audio is never grabbed and existing dual audio files can be replaced. - Any original language: Japanese by default, or Chinese, Korean and more, or each series' own from Sonarr (for donghua next to anime). - Dualarr-NVIDIA: Check files really runs on the GPU now. The CUDA backend needed a library (NCCL) that was missing from the image, so whisper quietly fell back to the CPU.
### 0.2.0 (2026-09-28) - Check files: whisper.cpp listens to each audio track and the subtitles are read, instead of trusting the language tags. Catches mislabelled releases, untagged tracks and signs & songs-only subtitles. - Runs on the CPU, an Intel or AMD iGPU (/dev/dri), or an NVIDIA GPU (the new Dualarr-NVIDIA template). - New optional settings in this template: the media folder, and /dev/dri for an iGPU.
### 0.1.0 (2026-09-28) - First release. - Checks every anime file's audio and subtitle languages from Sonarr's media info: dual audio, subbed, no subtitles, no Japanese audio. - One-click Sonarr setup: "Dual Audio" and "Dub Only" custom formats, scored in the quality profiles you pick. - Nightly scan with a paced search; Replace blocklists, deletes and re-searches files that break the rules. - Notifications (Discord, Telegram, ntfy, Gotify, webhook); login, API key for scripts.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Database (settings, login and the last scan). Keep it: everything you set up lives here.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Optional, for Check files: the folder with your anime, read-only. Easiest is the same host folder at the same container path Sonarr uses (e.g. /tv or /data); otherwise add a path mapping in Dualarr's Settings.

Config.Name: iGPU (Intel/AMD)
Config.Description: Optional, for Check files on an Intel or AMD integrated GPU: set to /dev/dri. Leave empty to check on the CPU. For an NVIDIA card, install Dualarr-NVIDIA instead.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as.

Config.Name: Reset login
Config.Description: Forgot the password? Set to true, start the container, create a new login in the web UI, then set this back to false. Settings are kept.
